rulesStrings.li: vox->I read it twice. Still don't know what it means for dinner.
vox->Can't say I'd heard of [FACTION_A] before today. Now I wish I hadn't.
vox->Interesting. Anyway, has anyone seen my good hat?
vox->Put it on the pile with everything else that's going to get us killed.
vox(TONE==grim)->Mark my words, this ends with all of us in a ditch.
vox(TONE==grim)->Bad news travels fast. Good news, apparently, doesn't travel at all.
vox(TONE==grim)->I've started sleeping with my boots on. This isn't helping.
vox(TONE==sunny)->Could be worse! Could be raining. Oh, it is raining. Still could be worse!
vox(TONE==sunny)->Every cloud has a silver lining, and every raider has silver in his pockets.
vox(TONE==sunny)->I'm sure it'll all work out. It usually does. Mostly. Sometimes.
vox(TONE==callous)->People die every day. Some of them even deserve it.
vox(TONE==callous)->Doesn't bother me. Does it bother you? Why?
vox(TONE==kind)->I hope the ordinary folk out there are all right. They never get a say in any of this.
vox(TONE==kind)->Someone should send them blankets. Or soup. Soup is always right.
vox(TONE==greedy)->Where there's trouble, there's a market. What's silver going for these days?
vox(TONE==greedy)->Does anyone over there need anything? At a fair price. My fair price.
vox(CAT==War)->Another war. Wake me when it's over, or when it's here. Whichever is first.
vox(CAT==War)->[FACTION_A] against [FACTION_B]. My money's on the crows.
vox(CAT==War)->If they're busy fighting each other, they're not busy fighting us. I'll drink to that.
vox(CAT==War)->I'm going to go check the turrets. No reason. Just checking them.
vox(CAT==War)->Someone tell the cook to stock up on pemmican. Wars make everyone hungry.
vox(CAT==War,TONE==grim)->It'll spill over. They always spill over. And we're downhill.
vox(CAT==War,TONE==grim)->Let me guess: the refugees come here, then the raiders follow the refugees.
vox(CAT==War,TONE==sunny)->At least the gravediggers will have steady work.
vox(CAT==War,TONE==callous)->Finally, something worth reading. Are there pictures?
vox(CAT==War,TONE==callous)->I could go over there and help. Either side. I'm not fussy.
vox(CAT==War,TONE==kind)->All those people, and for what? A hill? A grudge? It makes me sick.
vox(CAT==War,TONE==greedy)->Wars need steel, medicine and boots. We have steel, medicine and boots.
vox(CAT==Military)->If they're marching, I'd rather know which way.
vox(CAT==Military)->That many fighters in one place? Someone's having a very bad week soon.
vox(CAT==Military,TONE==grim)->They'll march past us. Or into us. Fifty-fifty.
vox(CAT==Military,TONE==callous)->Lot of gear walking around out there. Shame if it got lost.
vox(CAT==Diplomacy)->Treaties are just wars that haven't been scheduled yet.
vox(CAT==Diplomacy)->Good. Fewer people shooting means more people trading.
vox(CAT==Diplomacy)->Fancy words on fancy paper. I'll believe it when the caravans come back.
vox(CAT==Diplomacy)->Someone should send [LEADER_A] a fruit basket. Not a nice one. Just a basket.
vox(CAT==Diplomacy,TONE==grim)->Every handshake out here has a knife in the other hand.
vox(CAT==Diplomacy,TONE==sunny)->See? People can get along. Some of them. Briefly.
vox(CAT==Diplomacy,TONE==greedy)->Friendly factions buy more. I'm all for friendship.
vox(CAT==Council)->A council, voting on things. Like a family dinner, but with more knives.
vox(CAT==Council)->I don't remember voting for any of them. I don't remember voting at all.
vox(CAT==Council,TONE==grim)->Committees. That's how the world ends: by committee.
vox(CAT==Politics)->Leaders come, leaders go. The mud stays the same.
vox(CAT==Politics)->I'd riot too if I had to live in [CAPITAL_A].
vox(CAT==Politics)->Unstable neighbours are the worst kind. Ask anyone who has had them.
vox(CAT==Politics)->Whoever's in charge over there, I hope they're bad at raiding.
vox(CAT==Politics,TONE==grim)->Next will be worse. Next is always worse.
vox(CAT==Politics,TONE==callous)->If you ask me, they should have done it sooner and messier.
vox(CAT==Politics,TONE==kind)->Change is hard on people. I hope it's a gentle one.
vox(CAT==Economy)->So prices are going up again. Of course they are.
vox(CAT==Economy)->I've been saying for years we should keep more silver under the floor.
vox(CAT==Economy)->Their loss is our... no, wait, we trade with them. It's also our loss.
vox(CAT==Economy,TONE==greedy)->Buy low, sell high. Today is a buy low day. For someone.
vox(CAT==Economy,TONE==grim)->Next the caravans stop coming. Then we eat the furniture.
vox(CAT==Disaster)->Poor devils. And here I was complaining about the cooking.
vox(CAT==Disaster)->Let's keep our own fields watered and our own doors shut for a while.
vox(CAT==Disaster)->Hope it isn't catching. Whatever it is. Is it catching?
vox(CAT==Disaster)->Puts a bad harvest in perspective, doesn't it.
vox(CAT==Disaster,TONE==kind)->We should send them something. We have spare medicine, don't we?
vox(CAT==Disaster,TONE==callous)->Fewer of them means more for us. Don't look at me like that.
vox(CAT==Disaster,TONE==greedy)->Desperate people pay double for food. Just saying.
vox(CAT==Disaster,TONE==sunny)->They'll rebuild. People always do. Then something else happens.
vox(CAT==Espionage)->Spies. Everywhere. Possibly in this room. I'm not saying it's you.
vox(CAT==Espionage)->If it's in the paper, it wasn't much of a secret, was it.
vox(CAT==Espionage)->I'm locking my room tonight. And checking under the bed.
vox(CAT==Espionage,TONE==grim)->If they can do that to [FACTION_A], they can do it to us.
vox(CAT==Espionage,TONE==callous)->Clean work. Professional. I'd like to meet whoever did it.
vox(CAT==Culture)->A festival? I've forgotten what fun looks like. Is it the thing with the music?
vox(CAT==Culture)->Big arguments over small gods. Same as ever.
vox(CAT==Culture,TONE==sunny)->Good for them. Everyone deserves a party.
vox(CAT==General)->Fine, I was wrong. Again. Happy?
vox(CAT==General)->So it never happened? Then why did I hide the silver?
aside->A trader passing through confirmed the story in exchange for a hot meal and a dry corner.
aside->This report reached us in a sealed tin, slightly chewed.
aside->Our correspondent wishes it known that the tea was terrible.
aside->The original dispatch was partly illegible; the gaps have been filled with educated guesses.
aside(CAT==War)->Witnesses report that at least one muffalo was conscripted by mistake.
aside(CAT==War)->Local gravediggers have raised their prices.
aside(CAT==War)->Refugees on the road say both sides claim to be winning.
aside(CAT==War)->Black-market prices for medicine have doubled on the nearest routes.
aside(CAT==Military)->Travellers are advised to keep off the main roads and away from anything with a banner.
aside(CAT==Military)->The marching column was reportedly visible from three hills away, mostly because of the noise.
aside(CAT==Diplomacy)->Both delegations claim to have had the better seats.
aside(CAT==Diplomacy)->Refreshments at the talks were described as adequate and suspiciously well guarded.
aside(CAT==Politics)->Portraits of the old leadership were seen being used as firewood.
aside(CAT==Politics)->Street vendors in [CAPITAL_A] report brisk trade in new flags.
aside(CAT==Economy)->Caravan masters have begun charging "uncertainty fees".
aside(CAT==Economy)->A merchant was overheard offering to buy the news itself, at a discount.
aside(CAT==Disaster)->Healers in the area are asking for herbal medicine, clean water and patience.
aside(CAT==Disaster)->Survivors say the worst part was not the disaster, but the neighbours' advice.
aside(CAT==Espionage)->Officials deny everything, including things nobody asked about.
aside(CAT==Espionage)->A suspicious quantity of fake moustaches was found nearby.
aside(CAT==Culture)->Attendance was high, the music loud and the beer of questionable origin.
aside(CAT==Council)->The session ran long; three delegates were found asleep and one was found missing.
